facts.text: The gymnasium environment 'LocoMujoco' is registered with entry point loco_mujoco.core.wrappers.gymnasium:GymnasiumWrapper
GymnasiumWrapper's constructor takes env_name and builds the wrapped environment with RLFactory.make(env_name, **kwargs)
GymnasiumWrapper.step calls the wrapped environment and returns its five values unchanged: observation, reward, absorbing, done, info
GymnasiumWrapper.reset seeds numpy and jax from the seed when one is given and returns (observation, {})
render_fps is 1.0 / the wrapped environment's dt
LocoEnv's constructor defaults are n_substeps=10 and timestep=0.001
simulation_dt is the MuJoCo model's opt.timestep
The effective dt is simulation_dt * n_intermediate_steps * n_substeps
The inner environment starts with n_intermediate_steps set to 1
The base control function does not run at the simulation frequency
The inner environment advances the MuJoCo model with mujoco.mj_step for n_substeps
PDControl normalizes the agent's action space to [-1, 1]
Atlas's default action specification is the actuator list from back_bkz_actuator through l_leg_akx_actuator
The goal is appended to the observation specification

determinism.notes: the seed is a reset parameter; upstream seeds numpy and jax from it, this package's fake draws placeholder values from random.Random(seed), so a seed repeats a fake trajectory but not the upstream one

gaps: the upstream sim backend needs the upstream package plus its separate loco_mujoco_models model files and jax/numpy (install command pip install .), and was not run here; only the fake backend was checked

the fake backend is a placeholder: it starts from random placeholder joint values, adds the action to the position, and has no MuJoCo contacts, actuators, sensors, reward function or termination; it was never compared with the upstream environment

the fake returns 68 placeholder observation values (the 65 entries of Atlas's default observation specification plus the 3 GoalRandomRootVelocity goal values) and accepts 27 action values; these are test data, not the MuJoCo state
the reset seeds numpy and jax global state in upstream (gymnasium.py:89-94); the fake uses random.Random(seed), so one seed gives a different trajectory on the two
snapshot and restore are not offered: GymnasiumWrapper exposes no get_state or set_state
the 10 ms control step holds only because this driver pins env_kwargs timestep 0.001 s and n_substeps 10 (the upstream constructor defaults); another configuration or model file changes it

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last state stays readable and nothing is actuated
